title: 貨櫃鐵路場站吊運
titleEn: Container handling in intermodal rail terminals
summary: 本課聚焦貨櫃吊運載重分配擺動與場站節拍。從總重量與吊點均分建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把完整吊運循環率與吊具車輛與作業區交接連成可驗證的介面，最後以場站整合試驗工時整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
summaryEn: This course studies load distribution, sway and terminal throughput in intermodal lifting. Start with total load and mean lifting-point reaction to define physical or information boundaries, connect complete handling-cycle rate with spreader, vehicle and work-zone handoff as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through terminal integration-test effort. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 總重量與吊點均分與偏心貨載與支承反力
stages.titleEn: Total load and mean lifting-point reaction & Eccentric cargo and support reactions
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「總重量與吊點均分」與「偏心貨載與支承反力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Total load and mean lifting-point reaction" and "Eccentric cargo and support reactions": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 總重量與吊點均分：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Total load and mean lifting-point reaction: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「總重量與吊點均分」如何影響貨櫃鐵路場站吊運的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Total load and mean lifting-point reaction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Container handling in intermodal rail terminals”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先將貨櫃與吊具質量放進同一載重邊界，再計算對稱教學模型的平均吊點反力。將這個平均量與最不利吊點分開，不能由總能力足夠推論每點都有餘裕。平均吊點反力來自總重量分配，但實際分力受重心位置、支承剛度與同步誤差控制。動態倍率只是概念帳項，不能取代設備認證；把總能力除以吊點數也無法證明最不利吊點仍有足夠承載餘裕。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：對稱均分載重與假想動態倍率，非吊裝方案或設備額定能力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「總重量與吊點均分」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Include container and spreader mass within one load boundary before calculating symmetric mean reactions. Keep that mean distinct from the worst support; adequate total capacity does not prove margin at every point. Mean lifting reaction follows total load distribution, while actual reactions depend on centre of gravity, support stiffness and synchronization error. A dynamic factor is a conceptual accounting term, not equipment certification. Dividing total rating by support count does not establish margin at the most heavily loaded point. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Symmetric equal load sharing with an assumed dynamic factor, not a lifting plan or equipment rating. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Total load and mean lifting-point reaction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：總吊升質量 m=18000 kg；重力加速度 g=9.81 m/s2；承載點數 points=4 points；教學動態倍率 factor=1.15 1。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: lifted mass m=18000 kg; gravity g=9.81 m/s2; support count points=4 points; teaching dynamic factor factor=1.15 1.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「總起重能力足夠就能保證每個吊點都不會超載」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adequate total lifting capacity guarantees that no individual support is overloaded." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「總重量與吊點均分」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Total load and mean lifting-point reaction”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 總重量與吊點均分
knowledge.titleEn: Total load and mean lifting-point reaction
knowledge.text: 先將貨櫃與吊具質量放進同一載重邊界，再計算對稱教學模型的平均吊點反力。將這個平均量與最不利吊點分開，不能由總能力足夠推論每點都有餘裕。
knowledge.textEn: Include container and spreader mass within one load boundary before calculating symmetric mean reactions. Keep that mean distinct from the worst support; adequate total capacity does not prove margin at every point.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：總起重能力足夠就能保證每個吊點都不會超載 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adequate total lifting capacity guarantees that no individual support is overloaded. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「總重量與吊點均分」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Total load and mean lifting-point reaction" is correct?
options: 總起重能力足夠就能保證每個吊點都不會超載
先將貨櫃與吊具質量放進同一載重邊界，再計算對稱教學模型的平均吊點反力。
總重量不變時左右支承的載重也一定不變
optionsEn: Adequate total lifting capacity guarantees that no individual support is overloaded.
Include container and spreader mass within one load boundary before calculating symmetric mean reactions.
Unchanged total weight guarantees unchanged load at each support.
quiz.explanation: 先將貨櫃與吊具質量放進同一載重邊界，再計算對稱教學模型的平均吊點反力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Include container and spreader mass within one load boundary before calculating symmetric mean reactions. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 總重量與吊點均分：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Total load and mean lifting-point reaction: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「總重量與吊點均分」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Total load and mean lifting-point reaction” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：總吊升質量 m=18000 kg；重力加速度 g=9.81 m/s2；承載點數 points=4 points；教學動態倍率 factor=1.15 1。公式 y=m*g*factor/points/1000，代入得 y=50.7667 kN/point。邊界：對稱均分載重與假想動態倍率，非吊裝方案或設備額定能力。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: lifted mass m=18000 kg; gravity g=9.81 m/s2; support count points=4 points; teaching dynamic factor factor=1.15 1. Formula y=m*g*factor/points/1000 gives y=50.7667 kN/point. Boundary: Symmetric equal load sharing with an assumed dynamic factor, not a lifting plan or equipment rating. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在縮尺或空載試驗台核對各點高度與負載，逐步施加偏心以觀察反力重新分配。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: On a scale or unloaded test rig, compare support heights and loads, then introduce eccentricity to observe reaction redistribution.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：總吊升質量 m=18000 kg；重力加速度 g=9.81 m/s2；承載點數 points=4 points；教學動態倍率 factor=1.15 1。公式 y=m*g*factor/points/1000，代入得 y=50.7667 kN/point。邊界：對稱均分載重與假想動態倍率，非吊裝方案或設備額定能力。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: lifted mass m=18000 kg; gravity g=9.81 m/s2; support count points=4 points; teaching dynamic factor factor=1.15 1. Formula y=m*g*factor/points/1000 gives y=50.7667 kN/point. Boundary: Symmetric equal load sharing with an assumed dynamic factor, not a lifting plan or equipment rating.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「總重量與吊點均分」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Total load and mean lifting-point reaction", which statement holds?
options: 吊車馬達速度提高一倍場站吞吐就必定提高一倍
平均利用率低於百分之百就保證完全不會排隊
原創假想教學輸入：總吊升質量 m=18000 kg。
optionsEn: Doubling crane motor speed necessarily doubles terminal throughput.
Mean utilization below one hundred percent guarantees that no queue ever forms.
Original hypothetical teaching inputs: lifted mass m=18000 kg; gravity g=9.81 m/s2; support count points=4 points; teaching dynamic factor factor=1.15 1.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：總吊升質量 m=18000 kg；重力加速度 g=9.81 m/s2；承載點數 points=4 points；教學動態倍率 factor=1.15 1。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: lifted mass m=18000 kg; gravity g=9.81 m/s2; support count points=4 points; teaching dynamic factor factor=1.15 1. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 總重量與吊點均分：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Total load and mean lifting-point reaction: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「總重量與吊點均分」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Total load and mean lifting-point reaction” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在縮尺或空載試驗台核對各點高度與負載，逐步施加偏心以觀察反力重新分配。以「總重量與吊點均分」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: On a scale or unloaded test rig, compare support heights and loads, then introduce eccentricity to observe reaction redistribution. For total load and mean lifting-point reaction, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把總吊升質量 m 從 18000 改成 19800 kg（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 50.7667 變為 55.8434 kN/point。先說明「總重量與吊點均分」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only lifted mass m from 18000 to 19800 kg (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 50.7667 to 55.8434 kN/point. Explain the causal direction for total load and mean lifting-point reaction, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：一個吊點不同步會把載重移往其他支承，總載重不變也可能局部超載並扭曲貨櫃或吊具。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A lagging support transfers load to others; unchanged total weight can still produce local overload and container or spreader distortion. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在縮尺或空載試驗台核對各點高度與負載，逐步施加偏心以觀察反力重新分配。以「總重量與吊點均分」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。
knowledge.textEn: On a scale or unloaded test rig, compare support heights and loads, then introduce eccentricity to observe reaction redistribution. For total load and mean lifting-point reaction, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 只把總吊升質量 m 從 18000 改成 19800 kg（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 50.7667 變為 55.8434 kN/point。先說明「總重量與吊點均分」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Change only lifted mass m from 18000 to 19800 kg (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 50.7667 to 55.8434 kN/point. Explain the causal direction for total load and mean lifting-point reaction, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「總重量與吊點均分」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Total load and mean lifting-point reaction"?
options: 在縮尺或空載試驗台核對各點高度與負載，逐步施加偏心以觀察反力重新分配。
量測時不必記錄溫度、速度、運行歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
系統可用度很高就能直接證明所有故障都是安全的
optionsEn: On a scale or unloaded test rig, compare support heights and loads, then introduce eccentricity to observe reaction redistribution.
Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
High system availability directly proves that every failure is safe.
quiz.explanation: 在縮尺或空載試驗台核對各點高度與負載，逐步施加偏心以觀察反力重新分配。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: On a scale or unloaded test rig, compare support heights and loads, then introduce eccentricity to observe reaction redistribution. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 總重量與吊點均分：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Total load and mean lifting-point reaction: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「總重量與吊點均分」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Total load and mean lifting-point reaction” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 一個吊點不同步會把載重移往其他支承，總載重不變也可能局部超載並扭曲貨櫃或吊具。回到「總重量與吊點均分」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A lagging support transfers load to others; unchanged total weight can still produce local overload and container or spreader distortion. Trace the input chain for total load and mean lifting-point reaction. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：對稱均分載重與假想動態倍率，非吊裝方案或設備額定能力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Symmetric equal load sharing with an assumed dynamic factor, not a lifting plan or equipment rating.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「總起重能力足夠就能保證每個吊點都不會超載」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adequate total lifting capacity guarantees that no individual support is overloaded." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 一個吊點不同步會把載重移往其他支承，總載重不變也可能局部超載並扭曲貨櫃或吊具。回到「總重量與吊點均分」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: A lagging support transfers load to others; unchanged total weight can still produce local overload and container or spreader distortion. Trace the input chain for total load and mean lifting-point reaction. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「總重量與吊點均分」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Total load and mean lifting-point reaction" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
一個吊點不同步會把載重移往其他支承，總載重不變也可能局部超載並扭曲貨櫃或吊具。
總重量不變時左右支承的載重也一定不變
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
A lagging support transfers load to others; unchanged total weight can still produce local overload and container or spreader distortion.
Unchanged total weight guarantees unchanged load at each support.
quiz.explanation: 一個吊點不同步會把載重移往其他支承，總載重不變也可能局部超載並扭曲貨櫃或吊具。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A lagging support transfers load to others; unchanged total weight can still produce local overload and container or spreader distortion. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 偏心貨載與支承反力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Eccentric cargo and support reactions: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「偏心貨載與支承反力」如何影響貨櫃鐵路場站吊運的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Eccentric cargo and support reactions” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Container handling in intermodal rail terminals”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 貨物偏向一側會改變兩支承反力，即使總重量完全相同。用已知偏心的縮尺載具核對力與力矩平衡，觀察幾何中心和重心並非同一點。兩支承反力由力與力矩平衡同時決定。重心偏向一側時，該側反力增加而另一側減少，總和仍不變；平均反力看似充足不能掩蓋單側限制，支承接觸若脫離還會改變原先的邊界條件。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：剛體兩簡支靜力模型且兩支承保持接觸，忽略動態擺動。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「偏心貨載與支承反力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An off-centre load changes support reactions even when total weight is unchanged. Check force and moment balance on a scale load and distinguish geometric centre from centre of gravity. Two support reactions follow both force and moment equilibrium. Moving the centre of gravity toward one support raises that reaction while reducing the other without changing the total. Adequate mean reaction cannot hide a local limit, and loss of contact changes the assumed boundary conditions. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Rigid body on two simple supports that remain in contact, neglecting dynamic swing. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Eccentric cargo and support reactions” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：總載重 W=200 kN；支承間距 L=4 m；重心偏心 e=0.4 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: total load W=200 kN; support spacing L=4 m; centre-of-gravity eccentricity e=0.4 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「總重量不變時左右支承的載重也一定不變」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Unchanged total weight guarantees unchanged load at each support." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「偏心貨載與支承反力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Eccentric cargo and support reactions”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 偏心貨載與支承反力
knowledge.text: 貨物偏向一側會改變兩支承反力，即使總重量完全相同。用已知偏心的縮尺載具核對力與力矩平衡，觀察幾何中心和重心並非同一點。
knowledge.textEn: An off-centre load changes support reactions even when total weight is unchanged. Check force and moment balance on a scale load and distinguish geometric centre from centre of gravity.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：總重量不變時左右支承的載重也一定不變 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Unchanged total weight guarantees unchanged load at each support. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「偏心貨載與支承反力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Eccentric cargo and support reactions" is correct?
options: 總重量不變時左右支承的載重也一定不變
油壓讀值正常就能單獨保證負載永遠保持原位
貨物偏向一側會改變兩支承反力，即使總重量完全相同。
optionsEn: Unchanged total weight guarantees unchanged load at each support.
A normal hydraulic pressure reading alone guarantees that the load remains fixed indefinitely.
An off-centre load changes support reactions even when total weight is unchanged.
quiz.explanation: 貨物偏向一側會改變兩支承反力，即使總重量完全相同。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: An off-centre load changes support reactions even when total weight is unchanged. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 偏心貨載與支承反力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Eccentric cargo and support reactions: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「偏心貨載與支承反力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Eccentric cargo and support reactions” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：總載重 W=200 kN；支承間距 L=4 m；重心偏心 e=0.4 m。公式 y=W*(0.5+e/L)，代入得 y=120 kN。邊界：剛體兩簡支靜力模型且兩支承保持接觸，忽略動態擺動。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: total load W=200 kN; support spacing L=4 m; centre-of-gravity eccentricity e=0.4 m. Formula y=W*(0.5+e/L) gives y=120 kN. Boundary: Rigid body on two simple supports that remain in contact, neglecting dynamic swing. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對兩反力之和與各自力矩，再以已知小偏心移動驗證量測方向與零點。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check the reaction sum and moments, then apply a known small eccentricity to verify sensor direction and zero.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：總載重 W=200 kN；支承間距 L=4 m；重心偏心 e=0.4 m。公式 y=W*(0.5+e/L)，代入得 y=120 kN。邊界：剛體兩簡支靜力模型且兩支承保持接觸，忽略動態擺動。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: total load W=200 kN; support spacing L=4 m; centre-of-gravity eccentricity e=0.4 m. Formula y=W*(0.5+e/L) gives y=120 kN. Boundary: Rigid body on two simple supports that remain in contact, neglecting dynamic swing.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「偏心貨載與支承反力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Eccentric cargo and support reactions", which statement holds?
options: 原創假想教學輸入：總載重 W=200 kN；支承間距 L=4 m；重心偏心 e=0.4 m。
吊重質量加倍就一定使小角度單擺週期加倍
狀態變數多一個只會多出一種狀態組合
optionsEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: total load W=200 kN; support spacing L=4 m; centre-of-gravity eccentricity e=0.4 m.
Doubling suspended mass necessarily doubles the small-angle pendulum period.
Adding one Boolean state variable creates only one additional combination.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：總載重 W=200 kN；支承間距 L=4 m；重心偏心 e=0.4 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: total load W=200 kN; support spacing L=4 m; centre-of-gravity eccentricity e=0.4 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 偏心貨載與支承反力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Eccentric cargo and support reactions: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「偏心貨載與支承反力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Eccentric cargo and support reactions” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對兩反力之和與各自力矩，再以已知小偏心移動驗證量測方向與零點。以「偏心貨載與支承反力」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check the reaction sum and moments, then apply a known small eccentricity to verify sensor direction and zero. For eccentric cargo and support reactions, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把重心偏心 e 從 0.4 改成 0.44 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 120 變為 122 kN。先說明「偏心貨載與支承反力」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only centre-of-gravity eccentricity e from 0.4 to 0.44 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 120 to 122 kN. Explain the causal direction for eccentric cargo and support reactions, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把幾何中心當成重心會錯估分力，支承沉陷或接觸鬆脫又可能使靜力模型失效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Confusing geometric centre with centre of gravity misallocates load; settlement or loose contact can invalidate the static model. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對兩反力之和與各自力矩，再以已知小偏心移動驗證量測方向與零點。以「偏心貨載與支承反力」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。
knowledge.textEn: Check the reaction sum and moments, then apply a known small eccentricity to verify sensor direction and zero. For eccentric cargo and support reactions, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 只把重心偏心 e 從 0.4 改成 0.44 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 120 變為 122 kN。先說明「偏心貨載與支承反力」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Change only centre-of-gravity eccentricity e from 0.4 to 0.44 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 120 to 122 kN. Explain the causal direction for eccentric cargo and support reactions, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「偏心貨載與支承反力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Eccentric cargo and support reactions"?
options: 沿用另一處鐵路設施或路線的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
核對兩反力之和與各自力矩，再以已知小偏心移動驗證量測方向與零點。
測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險
optionsEn: Reusing results from another railway facility or route counts as verifying this structure.
Check the reaction sum and moments, then apply a known small eccentricity to verify sensor direction and zero.
One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.
quiz.explanation: 核對兩反力之和與各自力矩，再以已知小偏心移動驗證量測方向與零點。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check the reaction sum and moments, then apply a known small eccentricity to verify sensor direction and zero. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 偏心貨載與支承反力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Eccentric cargo and support reactions: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「偏心貨載與支承反力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Eccentric cargo and support reactions” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把幾何中心當成重心會錯估分力，支承沉陷或接觸鬆脫又可能使靜力模型失效。回到「偏心貨載與支承反力」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Confusing geometric centre with centre of gravity misallocates load; settlement or loose contact can invalidate the static model. Trace the input chain for eccentric cargo and support reactions. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：剛體兩簡支靜力模型且兩支承保持接觸，忽略動態擺動。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Rigid body on two simple supports that remain in contact, neglecting dynamic swing.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「總重量不變時左右支承的載重也一定不變」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Unchanged total weight guarantees unchanged load at each support." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把幾何中心當成重心會錯估分力，支承沉陷或接觸鬆脫又可能使靜力模型失效。回到「偏心貨載與支承反力」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Confusing geometric centre with centre of gravity misallocates load; settlement or loose contact can invalidate the static model. Trace the input chain for eccentric cargo and support reactions. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「偏心貨載與支承反力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Eccentric cargo and support reactions" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
油壓讀值正常就能單獨保證負載永遠保持原位
把幾何中心當成重心會錯估分力，支承沉陷或接觸鬆脫又可能使靜力模型失效。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A normal hydraulic pressure reading alone guarantees that the load remains fixed indefinitely.
Confusing geometric centre with centre of gravity misallocates load; settlement or loose contact can invalidate the static model.
quiz.explanation: 把幾何中心當成重心會錯估分力，支承沉陷或接觸鬆脫又可能使靜力模型失效。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Confusing geometric centre with centre of gravity misallocates load; settlement or loose contact can invalidate the static model. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
